 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 11 November 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You decided to be gentle and generous with your time, energy and effort; Taurus and the cosmos decided to return the favour. That spark within you that has been ignited, that idea or pull you feel towards a certain situation, person or goal—consider it. The resources, the help, the people will all make their way to you as you move along. You will have to juggle between things. There is no other way out, Cancer . But this time your guides advise you to play it smart. You tend to pour your heart into whatever you do. But this time, use your mind and logic as well. You know that transformation has been upon you for a long time, and perhaps for various reasons you may have been pushing it further and further along—waiting for the right conditions, the perfect timing or for life to settle down before you begin. And while you are trying your best to make the most of things, you also know that at some point in time it will get exhausting if you keep moving ahead in this manner, Pisces . Take a moment to strike a balance. To breathe. Things will work out.
 Read on for what the stars have in store for you and make sure you check out your sun, moon and rising signs for the complete picture.
 Aries Horoscope Today: November 11, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You may feel like you have been in this circle of attachment—a loop that isn't breaking. You work towards something, you receive a dopamine hit, and then you are back to the same loop of feeling like your happiness and peace are subject to your circumstances and probable security —and then you are back to the grind again. Now there are two ways of going about this—either this loop can keep continuing, or when you feel you are at an emotional high, ask yourself how you can maintain this balance that you are feeling in your life without really crashing and burning out like you have been doing. Make notes and figure out ways to put these ideas into practice.
 Cosmic tip: Instead of spiralling inwards, figure ways to make your ideas work for you.
 Taurus Horoscope Today: November 11, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You decided to be gentle and generous with your time, energy and effort; Taurus and the cosmos decided to return the favour. That spark within you that has been ignited, that idea or pull you feel towards a certain situation, person or goal—consider it. The resources, the help, the people will all make their way to you as you move along. Some of you may have received inheritances, or debts may have been paid off in some way, even if on a mental plane—clarity has set in. And this is your chance to use your time, energy, and effort wisely. Put your plans into action instead of simply dreaming about your aspirations.
 Cosmic tip: Try taking a leap, even a mini one.
 Gemini Horoscope Today: November 11, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Baggage is not easy to leave behind, especially the emotional kind, Gemini . And no one is saying that you must pick up and move on. All your guides are implying is that you recognise when the time to travel light has arrived. The new moon that has just gone by has ironically brought your self-worth to light and somehow broken some illusions. Are you ready for this different take and approach to life? Perhaps yes. But does it feel easy? Definitely not! Hang in there and keep moving.
 Cosmic tip: Your prayers are being answered. Stay open to whatever conspires. You are guarded.
 Cancer Horoscope Today: November 11, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You will have to juggle between things. There is no other way out, Cancer . But this time your guides advise you to play it smart. You tend to pour your heart into whatever you do. But this time, use your mind and logic as well. You know that transformation has been upon you for a long time and perhaps for various reasons you may have been pushing it further and further along—waiting for the right conditions, the perfect timing or for life to settle down before you begin? Perhaps life will settle down once you begin! So let your intuitive ideas take the lead as you chart out a plan of action to make them work.
 Cosmic tip: Old life cycles are ending. New ones are beginning.
 Leo Horoscope Today: November 11, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You may have been through a mentally rough and exhausting patch, Leo , and somehow keeping your cards close has become a guarded default program that surfaces on autopilot. The sun is shining, and remember that all you do is clearly visible to all, so hold your ethics and morals in the right place. Ask for space if you need some; draw that line if it is being overstepped. And most importantly, remember that just because people surround you, they need not have access to everything you do. Your gold nuggets are arriving. Patience and poise are the name of the game for you.
 Cosmic tip: Reach the shore; the storm is behind you.
 Virgo Horoscope Today: November 11, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Your vibe has been so existential lately, Virgo ! You know and understand that life is fickle, and hence the main theme you have been following in your actions is—how can you leave a gentler but more powerful impact? And this is wonderful! You have been staring out at the horizon for way too long, and now you seem to have made a choice. You no longer feel trapped in your head, your decisions and your life. You are constantly seeking the silver lining and moving on.
 Cosmic tip: Gratitude has become your way of life.
 Libra Horoscope Today: November 11, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You love security and stability. That's not the breaking news today, Libra . What is, is the fact that you may have been feeling strangled and trapped in loops that keep you feeling like a goblin focused on shiny collectables, when in actuality, a new life is waiting to break in through you. The cosmos is trying to redirect your attention to all that is possible for you, but the catch is that you need to pay attention to the signs and synchronicities first. If you care to look beyond your tears, life is actually bursting with sunshine.
 Cosmic tip: Get off the treadmill and take the scenic route.
 Scorpio Horoscope Today: November 11, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Your heart may have been pulling you in a certain direction and your gut in another. At this point in time, Scorpio , it is important for you to pay attention to your gut. That is leading you to greener pastures and happier times. Sometimes, to shift your narrative, you simply need to really decide to shift it; you need to interrupt yourself bang in the middle of a repetitive thought and course-correct. Sure, it takes a bit of practice, but it is not something that is impossible. And once you begin doing this, you begin noticing the new doors the cosmos is opening up for you.
 Cosmic tip: When you are in a good place, count your blessings and keep moving forward.
 Sagittarius Horoscope Today: November 11, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Your inner fire has a resounding and reverberating effect, Sag . Old ways may be creeping up in your heart and mind; however, you need to hold your vision and keep your stance to let your goals take shape and form. Eyes on the prize, Sagittarius. Be it a refreshed home life, a revamped career, a renewed inner dialogue or anything else—you mean business and you are seeking more meaning in life. Keep watering those seeds and watch them sprout.
 Cosmic tip: Take objective stock of your situation, adopt an elevated perspective and then make your decisions.
 Capricorn Horoscope Today: November 11, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) If you've been in a quandary, not knowing where to go, you may have simply been trying to keep going on a path that needs you to walk alone. Capricorn , in reality, nothing needs you to ever walk alone. Join forces, relearn your relationship patterns and take on the task of coming together to find solutions. Hard work and effort were never the challenge. You simply need to take off your blindfolds to see things for what they are.
 Cosmic tip: Relieve yourself of self-imposed limitations and take life on with your signature courage and strength.
 Aquarius Horoscope Today: November 11, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You decided that no matter what, you will survive, and Aquarius , are you doing it in style! You took some time to review things, to see the loopholes, to notice the glitches and refine your stance. Then you gained clarity and decided to move ahead. Has it been difficult? Yes. Is it still feeling like a struggle? Yes. But do you know in your heart you are heading in the right direction? You bet!
 Cosmic tip: Use your skills, wisdom and inner power to keep going.
 Pisces Horoscope Today: November 11, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) This is the balance of life. Pisces , things are being evened out. You asked for something, you prayed for it, but you may have gotten something slightly different than you imagined. And while you are trying your best to make the most of things, you also know that at some point in time it will get exhausting if you keep moving ahead in this manner. Take a moment to strike a balance. To breathe. Things will work out.
 Cosmic tip: Set your own pace instead of getting trapped in someone else's tracks.
